paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Ablation studies between Consistency-Bi and Consistency-Uni on test set of IWSLT14 De-En task of wait-k policy.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for three different consistency methods. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) on a linear scale, with values ranging from 1 to 9 and tick labels at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis represents BLEU scores on a linear scale, with values ranging from 18 to 32 and tick labels at regular intervals of 2. The plot shows three lines: one purple dashed line representing Consistency-CE, one green solid line with square markers representing Consistency-Uni, and one red solid line with star markers representing Consistency-Bi. The purple line starts at approximately (1, 19) and ends at approximately (9, 31), increasing steadily with a notable upward trend; the green line starts at approximately (1, 26) and ends at approximately (9, 32), also increasing steadily; and the red line starts at approximately (1, 26) and ends at approximately (9, 32), showing a similar steady increase.
